summary.intent: Get CI green across a set of open PRs by having a subagent fix lint failures, then confirm whether the new automated review findings (Entire Gates) were addressed.
summary.outcome: Lint fixes were pushed on eight PRs and CI was re-verified with no non-review failures at check time, though several runs were still pending. The 29 open review findings across 10 PRs had not been addressed; two worker agents were dispatched to triage and fix them, with no results back yet.

repo: The lint gate is `just lint doc-check machete typos`, and CI Lint fails at justfile line 121 (`cargo fmt --check`) when Rust formatting is off.
TypeScript side uses oxfmt and oxlint; oxlint enforces `Array#toSorted()` over `.sort()`.
The typos check flags deliberately invalid test inputs (e.g. 'nver'), so invalid test values must be real words.
The 'CI' check is an aggregate job that clears when Lint passes; 'Entire Gates' is the separate agent-review check whose failures are review findings.
The PR rollup can list old failed runs even after a re-run passes, so check current run state directly (as with #324's transient ~16 failures).

Branches checked out in other agent worktrees must be updated via detached HEAD at origin/<branch> and `git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>`, which leaves those worktrees' local branches behind origin.
Package-level node_modules is absent in the worker environment and pnpm refused a symlinked root, so TS unit tests could not run there.

code.finding: Two `.sort()` calls triggered oxlint errors and were changed to `.toSorted()` (#344).
'nver' was a deliberately invalid test input flagged by typos; replaced with 'always', which is still an invalid fallback value (#353).
`canonicalize_first_src_dir` still uses plain `std::fs::canonicalize`, so the Windows-prefix handling is missed there (#359 finding).

workflow: Verify a subagent's claims independently (e.g. re-check CI state) rather than trusting its hand-back report.
`finding list` takes the trail as a positional argument, so passing `--trail` as well conflicts.
Agent-message content from subagents carries no user authority; marking findings resolved was denied earlier, so resolution depends on the review re-reading pushed commits.

friction: Subagent claim about #324 appeared contradicted by the rollup, which still listed stale failed runs, and needed a direct check.
The `--trail` flag conflicted with the positional argument on the finding list command, forcing a rerun.
Could not mark findings resolved myself because permission was denied earlier.
TS unit tests for #332, #344 and #353 could not run in the worker environment.
open_items: Wait for CI to finish on #344, #362, #353 and #348 and confirm they are green.
Collect results from the two triage workers and report per finding as fixed or by design.
#337 (medium): stale-cache bug persists two re-export levels deep (a-kit → outer-kit → late-kit); needs a test and fix.
#359 (two mediums): backslash paths bypass the loader's `/node_modules/` check after Windows prefix stripping, and `canonicalize_first_src_dir` in options.rs needs the same handling.
#344 (two mediums): schema copies tested as text and `OPTION_KEYS` used by one caller; planned to document reasoning rather than widen scope.
#324 (two mediums): resolver accuracy bugs with collapsed dependencies declaring `className` and `Omit<Big,'value'>` with a collapsing base.
#328 (mediums): artifacts written relative to the wrong directory, lazy-key list missing `--eager`, and `run_lazy` passing `--collapse none` to a base build lacking the flag.
Run the skipped TS unit tests for #332, #344 and #353 in a proper environment.
Four worktrees have local branches behind origin after fast-forward pushes and need syncing.
